name: AutoDeafen for Linux
description: Deafens Discord during good runs on Linux. No keybinds, no Discord plugin.

enabled.name: Enabled By Default
enabled.description: Turns AutoDeafen on for levels you have not set up in the pause menu.

percent.name: Default Deafen Percent
percent.description: Where to deafen in levels you have not set up in the pause menu.

end.name: Default Undeafen Percent
end.description: Where to undeafen. 100 keeps you deafened until the run is over.
